## What Does This Change?

A clear description of what this PR changes and why.

## Motivation

Why is this change needed? Link to the issue it resolves (e.g., `Closes #123`)
or explain the problem it solves.

## Notes

Anything the reviewer should know (migration steps, perf impact, etc.).

---

> **Labels, categories, and documentation completeness are enforced automatically.**
>
> - **Labels**: auto-applied by file paths (area labels) and PR title prefix (type labels).
>   Use conventional commit prefixes: `feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `test:`, `chore:`, `ci:`.
> - **Documentation**: CI runs `validate-pr-docs.py` and blocks merge if code changes
>   lack corresponding doc updates. See `docs/docmap.toml` for the code→doc map.
> - **Changelog**: release-drafter auto-categorizes from labels. No manual listing needed.
